Sam: quick check — i'm about to merge the docs PR that collates 429 + timeout troubleshooting items into a single matrix. wanted to flag any outstanding SDK snippet or link fixes before i do.

Mike: i updated the Go retry example yesterday but didn't touch the JS/TS section. also left a TODO on the backpressure paragraph about the `Retry-After` header handling.

Elaine: heads-up — the runbook links changed last week, some old anchors broke. i can run a quick link-checker but need the final PR to be stable first.

Sam: list here — JS/TS retry snippet, JS streaming fallback example, context-trim snippet, and link anchors under /guides/error-handling.

Anya: ok i'll take JS/TS retry + streaming fallback. Mike — can you paste the Go diff here so i can mirror the patterns?

Mike: sure — snippet below. feel free to adapt.

```go
// simple exponential backoff with max attempts
func Retry(ctx context.Context, call func() error) error {
  backoff := time.Millisecond * 200
  for i := 0; i < 5; i++ {
    if err := call(); err == nil { return nil }
    time.Sleep(backoff)
    backoff *= 2
  }
  return errors.New("max retries")
}
```

Anya: perfect, copying into JS/TS with the SDK's `retryWithPolicy` snippet. i'll include a note about honoring `Retry-After` when `429` includes it.
